SELECT a.*, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, c.name AS categoryName FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id
a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 2
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND a.id IN (SELECT article_id FROM article_tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
AND MATCH(a.title, a.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.publish_time DESC
